description: The sales tax exemption certificates on file in one set of books: customers' certificates (RECEIVED) and the business's own given to suppliers (ISSUED), with jurisdiction, reason, validity and state (ACTIVE, EXPIRING, EXPIRED, REVOKED), plus a count per jurisdiction.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

contactId.description: Only this customer or vendor (a contact id from find_contacts).

direction.description: RECEIVED (from customers) or ISSUED (to suppliers); empty for both.

jurisdiction.description: A province or state code such as CA-BC or US-TX.

state.description: ACTIVE, EXPIRING, EXPIRED, NOT_YET_VALID or REVOKED.

name: tax_exemption_certificates
title: Exemption certificates on file
